sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto adoption is structurally tied to remittance and cross-border payment corridors, favoring scalable layer-1s like Stellar and Algorand over speculative tokens.

sectors.ai: Rotate into layer-1s with proven staking yield and Indonesia-accessible liquidity—ALGO, ATOM, AVAX lead momentum and offer real on-chain activity versus meme-driven pumps. Rebalance toward ADA and DOT for relative safety, and watch for a pullback to add AVAX below $30.
